bullets: Built a validation layer with Zod that checks every AI chatbot response against a fixed schema, catching malformed output and retrying before it ever reaches a user.
Secured the app with Firebase Authentication and Vercel KV (Redis) rate limiting, blocking abusive traffic before it reaches the backend.
Added Sentry error logging so production failures surface right away, cutting debugging time on the early-stage app.
tech: TypeScript, Node.js, Zod, Firebase Auth, Vercel KV (Redis), Sentry

bullets: Worked directly with the owner to replace printed menus with a customer-facing online storefront for roughly 100 daily customers, built in React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
Built a Supabase admin portal so staff can update menus, prices, and availability themselves — no developer needed for day-to-day changes.
Cut image sizes by roughly 90% by converting to WebP, keeping page loads fast and the site inside the client's hosting budget.
tech: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Node.js, Vercel

bullets: Built a Flutter app used by roughly 150 students to practice the steps of going to a cinema: buying a ticket, finding a seat, and navigating the building.
Gathered accessibility requirements directly from the school's special-education staff, so students with disabilities could navigate and locate seats on their own.
